description: Look up one electronic or industrial part number (or a cable name such as "F-CV 2.5SQ 3C" or "HFIX 2.5SQ") on BIDON, the Korean B2B parts marketplace. Returns Korean sale listings with quantity and price, real recent quotes in KRW with lead time (buyer names hidden), manufacturer specs, same-spec alternatives from other makers, and whether BIDON supplies it directly (MEAN WELL, MORNSUN, CLAF: quote by the same business day). Every result starts with a one-paragraph summary of availability and how to buy, and links the part page where the user can buy or request a quote.

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number, e.g. LRS-150-24 or B0505S-1WR3
